column3: MT 60:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. Close to the Hebrew; the tune is translated “Set to ‘Lily of the Testimony,’” “Aram Naharaim” is “Mesopotamia,” “Aram Zobah” “Syria of Zobah,” and NKJV supplies “killed twelve thousand Edomites.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wine of staggering” is rendered “the wine of confusion.”
NKJV renders מִפְּנֵי קֹשֶׁט (“because of the bow”) as “because of the truth,” reading a similar word.
Close to the Hebrew; “the protection of my head” is rendered “the helmet for My head,” and מְחֹקְקִי (“my scepter”) “My lawgiver.”
Close to the Hebrew; סִיר רַחְצִי (“my washbasin”) is rendered “My washpot,” and “over me, O Philistia, shout” “Philistia, shout in triumph because of Me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a city of fortification” is rendered “the strong city.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִצָּר (“from the foe”) is rendered “from trouble,” and “worthless” “useless.”
